findings.summary: Y7 reachability declaration for Y5 is false. The dev-note names test/g10-per-role-runid.test.ts > Y5 > "GenerateSpawnRuntime has newRunId not runId; TriageSpawnRuntime retains runId" as the unique case that fails when triage/worker run-id generation regresses, but that case only inspects the generate runtime obtained from assembleGenerateDeps (expects no `runId`, expects `newRunId`). If triage's `runId: randomUUID()` (src/tick-run.ts:1540) or the worker's per-dispatch `randomUUID()` (src/tick.ts:416) regressed to a hoisted single value, the named test would still pass, so it cannot be the guard the spec requires. The fallback justification given is a TypeScript type error, which `npx vitest run` does not evaluate.

Hard acceptance criterion Y8 is not delivered. Spec §2 Y8 requires `git status --porcelain` to be empty with the output pasted, and §2 declares the table 缺一不可; the dev-note instead carries the placeholder "（最终提交后验证）" with no output, so the criterion is unevidenced rather than met.

The Y5 test is vacuous and mislabeled: its name asserts "TriageSpawnRuntime retains runId" but the body contains only two assertions about the generate runtime (`not.toHaveProperty("runId")`, `toHaveProperty("newRunId")`), exactly duplicating the Y3 case at lines 116-118. It adds no regression guard for the path Y5 exists to protect.

Indentation of the triage assembly's `runId: randomUUID(),` was flattened to column 0 while its sibling properties keep 12-space indentation, indicating an incidental edit inside a region spec §5 lists as explicitly out of scope. The value itself is unchanged and behaviour is unaffected, but the stray formatting change should not be in this package.

Y1 is verified by four sequential direct `spawnGenerateRole` calls over a hardcoded ROLES list rather than by one `runGenerate` invocation, while spec §2 Y1 phrases the criterion as "一次 runGenerate 里 advocate / opponent / judge / synthesizer 落到 argv 上的 --run-id 互不相同". The runtime does come from production `assembleGenerateDeps`, so Y4 is satisfied, but a hoisted run-id introduced inside `runGenerate` itself (rather than in the runtime) would not be caught.
